description:
**BagOS gates every AI-initiated Solana spend: token-gated, SOL-capped, confirmed on chain.**

An MCP server that can move money hands an AI assistant a signing key. The assistant decides, and the transaction is already on chain by the time a human reads about it. BagOS makes it pause.

The first call to a write tool **signs nothing**. It returns a preview and a single-use confirmation token fingerprinted to the exact arguments, so a token issued for a 0.01 SOL swap cannot authorize a 10 SOL one. Nothing reaches the chain until you call again with that token.

### Every write goes through this — in order

`token gate → spend caps → confirmation → simulate → sign → send → confirm`

- **Hard caps** — 0.1 SOL per transaction, 1 SOL per session, enforced before the Bags SDK is called
- **Single-use tokens** — expire in 5 minutes and are bound to exact arguments
- **Simulate before signing** — a failed simulation aborts the write
- **Confirmed, or it throws** — never a success message for a transaction that did not land
- **Devnet by default** — writes are mainnet-only, so an unconfigured install cannot spend real money

### 14 tools

**11 read** — never sign, never spend: heartbeat, authenticate, trade quotes, token analytics, top creators, per-token creators, claim stats, claim events, claimable fees, partner stats, social-handle → launch-wallet resolution.

**1 gated** — `bags_prepare_token_metadata` reserves a mint and uploads metadata, then says plainly that nothing was launched. Completing a launch needs a Meteora fee-share split, which is your decision rather than a model's.

**2 write** — `bags_execute_trade` and `bags_claim_fees`. Mainnet only, off unless you configure them.

### Proof

345 tests at 100% coverage — statements, branches, functions and lines — enforced in CI. Published from CI with SLSA provenance. Listed in the official MCP registry.

Docs and live demo: https://bagos.edycu.dev

bags_api_key.title: Bags API key
bags_api_key.description: Needed before any tool can return data — every call fails without it. Left optional so the server installs and lists its tools first, and you can add the key once you have one. Create one at https://dev.bags.fm under API Keys.

bags_network.title: Solana cluster
bags_network.description: devnet or mainnet. Bags has no devnet deployment, so trading and fee claims require mainnet — but devnet is the default so an unconfigured install cannot spend real money.

bos_token_mint.title: Gate token mint
bos_token_mint.description: Mint address of the token that gates the write tools. Without it, write tools fail their gate check.

bags_keypair_path.title: Solana keypair file
bags_keypair_path.description: Only needed for trading and fee claims. Leave empty to run read-only. Create one with: solana-keygen new -o ~/.config/bags/keypair.json

bags_max_sol_per_tx.title: Max SOL per transaction
bags_max_sol_per_tx.description: Hard cap on what any single transaction may spend. A write exceeding this is refused before signing.

bos_required_balance.title: Gate token balance required
bos_required_balance.description: Minimum balance of the gate token needed to call a write tool.

bags_max_sol_per_session.title: Max SOL per session
bags_max_sol_per_session.description: Hard cap on total SOL spent across one server session. Resets when the server restarts.
